Subsetting simulacr objects

Source: R/subset.R
subset.simulacr.Rd

This method allows you to subset a simulacr object by retaining specified individuals, data from a select time frame, cases or non-cases. When several selection criteria are used, only individuals fulfilling all criteria are kept. Subsetting is done on the linelist first, and edges are trimmed to remove transmission pairs involving individuals not listed in the linelist.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'simulacr'
subset(
  x,
  id = TRUE,
  start_date = NULL,
  end_date = NULL,
  casedef = c("case", "non_case"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A simulacr object as returned by simulate_outbreak().

id

A vector of logical, integer, or character indicating the subset of individuals identifiers to select. Recycled as needed. Defaults to TRUE, in which case all individuals are kept.

start_date

A single integer indicating the minimum date (inclusive) of infection for individuals to be retained. Note that all non-infected individuals have a date of infection of -1.

end_date

A single integer indicating the maximum date (inclusive) of infection for individuals to be retained. Note that all non-infected individuals have a date of infection of -1.

casedef

A character vector listing all case definition (normally case or non_case) to be retained.

...

further arguments to be passed to other methods (for compatibility with the subset generic)
